title: Man in Mirror
description: A surreal painting viewed through a dark doorway or frame. In the center of a deep blue-black wall hangs a small framed portrait of a young man with light brown hair taking a selfie with a smartphone, his reflection visible within the picture.
prompt: A surreal dark interior scene viewed through a doorway with dramatic red and black painted wooden frame. Centered on a deep midnight blue wall is a small black framed painting showing a young man with light brown hair wearing a black t-shirt taking a selfie with his smartphone, his own reflection captured within the picture. Cinematic lighting with a glowing orange vertical light strip on the right and a curved red upholstered element visible on the lower right. Moody and mysterious atmosphere with signature in the corner.
